chi_deposit.independence_caveat: Repeated/group bookings may violate independent observations. Exploratory association, not causality; no multiplicity correction.

cleaning.policy: Keep duplicates, zero ADR and finite positive extremes; exclude negative ADR, negative counts, zero known guests and zero nights. Missing children remain unknown; train-only median imputation. IQR tails may represent real demand: retain rather than data-dependent trimming; log/winsorization are alternatives not tuned on test.

classification.x_overlap_interpretation: Different original reservations can share conservative X values. These are diagnosed, not removed or grouped by target-erased predictors. No exact original row crosses partitions.
classification.redundancy_policy: Keep adults, children and babies in X so known adults survive missing children; median-impute children on train only. Exclude total_guests from X: its exact sum is redundant when complete and its unknown total must not be independently imputed. Preserve total_guests (null when any component is unknown) in cleaned and task/split Parquet for traceability, not as a model predictor. Keep total_nights instead of its night components. Full OHE is redundant with intercept; LinearRegression uses least squares/SVD, not coefficient inference. Logistic uses default L2; no advanced regularized regression or tuning.
classification.split_policy: Target row weights 75/12.5/12.5 within each class (classification) or overall (regression); original-fingerprint groups sorted largest first with seed42 random tie-breaks, then assigned to greatest relative row deficit among bins where the group fits. Ties prefer larger target then fixed split order; group-size ties use seed42. If no bin fits, minimize the increase in squared relative target error. Validate train row fraction 70%-80% and nonempty holdouts before fitting/exporting. Intact groups can prevent exact target sizes; greedy assignment is not an exhaustive feasibility solver.

imbalance.treatment: No resampling: minority is not severe (threshold 10%); regression conditioned on non-cancellation.

phase2.interpretation: Fixed baselines, no hyperparameter selection; validation and test reported separately. Snapshot is day prior to arrival, not creation. Arrival-based random grouped holdouts do not establish future performance. Regression ADR=sum lodging transactions/nights in non-canceled bookings; conditional population has selection bias. Finite extreme ADR retained; metrics are tail-sensitive. Hash collision risk is negligible, not mathematically impossible.

excluded_features.adr: transaction-derived outcome, not proven quoted tariff
excluded_features.country: may be known only at check-in
excluded_features.agent/company: nominal identifiers; NULL means not applicable
excluded_features.arrival_date_year/week/day: omit redundant calendar components; month is nominal
excluded_features.is_canceled: classification target; regression population condition only

clustering.partition: Fase 2, partición de clustering sin estratificar (split_bookings(classification=False))

k_decision.decision: manual: elbow and seed stability (no K met every automatic criterion)
